meta.plot: Kim Seo-hui’s life is changed forever when her politician father dies in a car crash and her husband disappears – all in one day. She enters the world of politics and join hands with small-town detective Jo Tae-sik to uncover the truth when she finds out that the car crash might not have been an accident after all.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Hand
1.plot: Jo Tae-sik inspects an apparent suicide. After learning that Kim Seung-cheol died in a car accident, Kim Seo-hui can’t get a hold of Jeong Sang-hun.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Target
1.plot: Tae-sik and his team look into Sang-hun's disappearance -- and learn he and Seung-cheol were working on something together.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Bait
1.plot: When a factory worker he'd been trying to find turns up dead, Tae-sik investigates. Seo-hui forces herself through a tough campaign trail.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Restart
1.plot: Another grisly package surfaces. Tae-sik and his team suspect In Dong-gu is involved. Seo-hui tries to understand a bill that her party wants passed.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Other Side
1.plot: Suspecting something is amiss at the mental hospital, the cops send Jeon Ho-gyu undercover. Seo-hui eavesdrops on Hong Min-guk and Dong-gu.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Disappear
1.plot: Tae-sik untangles the mystery of the mental hospital -- but Sang-hun remains missing. Seo-hui confronts Jeong Yeong-mun about what he knew.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Jealousy
1.plot: The search for answers continues as the police turn their attention to Jin Yeong-min, who turns out to have a long history with Sang-hun.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Eye
1.plot: Seo-hui comes clean to Tae-sik about the mysterious messages she's been hiding, and probes into a funeral Sang-hun attended before he vanished.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - KEY
1.plot: While Tae-sik's reinvestigation into Choe Su-hyeon's death ruffles feathers left and right, Seo-hui asks around about her connection to Sang-hun.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Bottomless Pit
1.plot: Ignoring his suspension, Tae-sik chases leads from the list in the USB drive with Seo-hui. Kang Jin-gyeong brings Ho-gyu the dead laptop.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Framed
1.plot: Tae-sik recovers the list while on the run from authorities. Meanwhile, Jin-gyeong gets to the bottom of who framed him.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Disclosure
1.plot: Tae-sik and Jin-gyeong channel their grief into helping Seo-hui, who discovers a startling truth about what connects the people on the list.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Real Intention
1.plot: Getting their hands on damning evidence allows Tae-sik and Jin-gyeong to set a trap. Seo-hui receives another message.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Survivor
1.plot: Trying to turn votes against the bill, Seo-hui holds a press conference. Tae-sik tails Yeong-min, who has his own plans for the future of JQ Group.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Original Sin
1.plot: If Seo-hui wants to save Sang-hun, she must find one last crucial piece of evidence among her father's things. Yeong-min delivers an ultimatum.

1.title: EN - The Lies Within [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Those Who Were Silent, Those Who Were Not
1.plot: Yeong-min and Dong-gu have a final face-to-face. A heartbreaking letter from Sang-hun is difficult to swallow for Seo-hui, but doubly so for Yeong-mun.

meta.plot: Gong Woo-Jin is a 30-year-old single man and he works as a set designer. Due to a trauma he experienced 13 years ago, he does not want to have a relationship with others. When Woo Seo-Ri  was 17, she fell into a coma. 13 years later, she wakes up from her coma. Her mental age is still that of a 17-year-old, but she is now 30-years-old. Gong Woo-Jin and Woo Seo-Ri get involved with each other and fall in love.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - La Campanella
1.plot: 17-year-old violinist Woo Seo Ri becomes comatose after a major bus crash. Gong Woo Jin, a 17-year-old boy who likes her, witnesses the whole thing. 13 years later, at age 30, Seo Ri wakes up.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Where Are My Uncle and Aunt?
1.plot: Seo Ri wakes up from her coma and realizes she is 30; Woo Jin's sister calls him back to Seoul.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Elegant Ghost
1.plot: Seo Ri learns that her aunt and uncle have moved.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Room Under the Stairs
1.plot: Woo Jin, Chan, and Jennifer all hear something during the night. They go the first floor and are shocked to see something coming out of a cabinet. Seo Ri stays the night at Woo Jin's place and reveals how this house became as it is now.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Lands of the Unknown
1.plot: Hyung Tae is eager to find Seo Ri and looks everywhere. Seo Ri finds out that the hospital is searching for her, yet decides not to return. Seo Ri realizes that Woo Jin used to go to school in Germany which made her curious about Woo Jin.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Replacement
1.plot: Seo Ri fails to make the cut for the orchestra, and Chan helps to comfort her feelings. While eating tteokbokki together, Seo Ri receives good news from the violin academy that she can perform for 2 to 3 weeks as a substitute.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - What If You Die Because of Me
1.plot: Seo Ri sees a man who she thinks is her uncle while heading somewhere in a car. When she tries to runs to him while the car is still moving, Woo Jin encounters flashbacks of a bad memory and grabs Seo Ri to stop her from running.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Apology
1.plot: Once Seo Ri realizes that she may have confused some other man as her uncle, Seo Ri feels regretful for talking so cruelly toward Woo Jin and chooses to apologize to him.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Moonlight
1.plot: Woo Jin sees Seo Ri going into a bar while he is having a meeting with his clients. He follows Seo Ri and shouts her name loudly to find her, but soon gets dragged out by the bouncer.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Flashbacks
1.plot: While both Woo Jin and Chan have feelings for Seo Ri, each have very different approaches toward Seo Ri.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - I'm Scared
1.plot: Seo Ri joins Hee Su's team to help her organize a music festival. However, Woo Jin feels uncomfortable with the situation and confronts Hee Su about the matter.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Did I Do Something Wrong?
1.plot: Seo Ri gets drunk during the team dinner, and accidently enters Woo Jin's room which brings a very awkward situation the next morning. Woo Jin tries to avoid Seo Ri to hide his feelings, but it get harder and harder.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Bar 7
1.plot: Woo Jin sees his doctor and confesses that Seo Ri made him change to be a different person from what he used to be. Meanwhile, Chan decides to express his feelings towards Seo Ri after winning at the national competition.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - I Want My Time Back
1.plot: Woo Jin gets drunk while he was trying to protect Seo Ri from Mr. Kang at the bar. Afterwards, Woo jin's behavior makes Seo Ri question the reason behind it.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Feeding the Fish
1.plot: Seo Ri is looking for a place to stay and Hyun’s cousin’s place becomes her favorite option as everything is free to use there. Chan is crushed to hear that she will move out since he has plans to admit his feelings for her.

1.title: EN - Still 17 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Intermission
1.plot: Woo Jin takes Seo Ri to the ocean to cheer her up; Seo Ri shares her perspective with Woo Jin, who feels sorry for how he treated her.

meta.plot: During a perilous 24-hour mission on the moon, space explorers try to retrieve samples from an abandoned research facility steeped in classified secrets.

1.title: EN - The Silent Sea [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Balhae Lunar Research Station
1.plot: Director Choi's briefing about the mission leaves Song Ji-an displeased. Reaching the research station alone proves no easy feat for the crew.

1.title: EN - The Silent Sea [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Three Storages
1.plot: The crew's initial findings are at odds with their knowledge of the research station. Split into threes, the members set out to look for the sample.

1.title: EN - The Silent Sea [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Cause of Death
1.plot: Ji-an's body cam captures a startling moment of life and death. Submerged in sweat, Gong Soo-chan shows worrisome signs of an unusual infection.

1.title: EN - The Silent Sea [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Truth Comes Out
1.plot: Han Yun-jae updates the director and gets access to a restricted area. The crew learns of the sample's powers and the true motive behind their mission.

1.title: EN - The Silent Sea [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Secret Storage
1.plot: Recalling her sister's encrypted message, Ji-an searches the database for Luna. A young intruder and a double-crosser emerge from the shadows.

1.title: EN - The Silent Sea [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Key to Salvation
1.plot: E2, Ryu Tae-suk and the samples go missing. Seeing a familiar name on the intruder, Ji-an follows her down the vents for answers.

1.title: EN - The Silent Sea [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Luna
1.plot: Ji-an opens a hard drive that chronicles Song Won-kyung's life and work on the station. Meanwhile, others uncover the remains of the experiment.

1.title: EN - The Silent Sea [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Silent Sea
1.plot: Racing against time as the research station falls under destruction, the surviving crew members decide on the fate of the mission — and their own.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E01 - A Bunch of Smart Orphans
1.plot: A good-hearted, unusually gifted orphan named Reynie Muldoon enters a competition to win a scholarship to the prestigious Boatwright Academy. While undergoing a grueling series of tests, Reynie joins forces with two other uniquely gifted orphans, Sticky Washington and Kate Wetherall, and the three of them work together to tackle the challenges in their path. The children are introduced to a fourth gifted orphan, Constance Contraire, and finally to the enigmatic Mr. Benedict.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E02 - Carrying a Bird
1.plot: Mr. Benedict lays out the world-changing stakes of his top-secret mission to Reynie, Sticky, Kate, and Constance: The Emergency is out of control, and the only way to stop it is to infiltrate the mysterious L.I.V.E. Institute on Harbor Island. Our young heroes embark on an undercover operation as transfer students at the school, and learn to navigate unfriendly fellow students, bizarre, nonsensical classes, and a shockingly familiar Headmaster.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E03 - Depends on the Wagon
1.plot: The kids of the Mysterious Benedict Society come to a grim realization about Dr. Curtain’s methods of keeping secrets. They also learn the dire consequences to the mission if they were to slip to the bottom of their classes: they would be kicked out. After receiving a message from the children, Mr. Benedict and his crew investigate his possible connection to Dr. Curtain. The children resolve to learn more about the elite Messenger program at the school.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E04 - A Whisper, Not a Shout
1.plot: The children make a risky play to search for clues right under Dr. Curtain’s nose. Mr. Benedict and Milligan head out into rugged terrain to do some recon of their own. Rhonda and Number Two butt heads about their unique approaches to fighting The Emergency. Sticky gets caught trying to help Kate cheat, and finds out the next phase of Dr. Curtain’s insidious plot. Kate suffers a blow to her academic standing but finds a saving grace in Martina Crowe and her tetherball team.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E05 - The Art of Conveyance and Round-Trippery
1.plot: Reynie and Sticky investigate secret transmissions. Constance and Kate explore the island.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E07 - The Dance of the Celestial Orb
1.plot: Kate embarks on a rogue mission into Dr. Curtain’s secret lab which ends in disaster. Mr. Benedict, Number Two, and Rhonda decide to take matters into their own hands. Reynie accuses Sticky of being taken in by Dr. Curtain’s charismatic ways, while Kate’s deception makes Martina a target. Reynie is called into Dr. Curtain’s office for interrogation. Constance’s unique sensitivity to the Whisperer comes to a head, and the team realizes that their time is running out.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E08 - Big Day Today
1.plot: Mr. Benedict, Rhonda, and Number Two arrive at The Institute, ready to take down Dr. Curtain and his minions. The kids form an elaborate plan to destroy the Whisperer once and for all. Milligan’s shocking connection to Dr. Curtain is revealed. Dr. Curtain prepares to take an aggressive step forward in The Improvement. The kids, Benedict’s team, and Dr. Curtain face off in a climactic final showdown, the fate of society itself hanging in the balance.

meta.plot: Un groupe d’orphelins infiltré dans un internat s’efforce de contrecarrer un projet machiavélique d’ampleur planétaire et se découvre par la même occasion une nouvelle famille...
Top bakers and engineers team up to build edible creations that must taste delicious and survive intense engineering stress tests to win $100,000.

1.title: EN - Baking Impossible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Whatever Floats Your Boat
EN - Baking Impossible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Off to the Robot Races
EN - Baking Impossible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Sweet Chain Reactions
EN - Baking Impossible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Fore! The Love of Mini Golf
EN - Baking Impossible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Cake on the Catwalk
EN - Baking Impossible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Baking to New Heights

meta.plot: Eight professionals study the art of chocolate under the guidance of a well-known chocolatier. But only one can be the best in class and win a unique opportunity.

1.title: EN - School of Chocolate [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Breaking Molds and Bending Chocolate
1.plot: The chefs create edible illusions, including a planter box with earthy flavors, then form teams to bend chocolate into architectural shapes.

1.title: EN - School of Chocolate [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Dessert Deception
1.plot: From a coconut cake croque madame to a taco packed with chocolate popcorn, deceiving desserts fool the senses. The chefs learn to polish chocolate.

1.title: EN - School of Chocolate [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Make It Ooze
1.plot: A tense class vote follows a near disaster with a towering chocolate showpiece. Later, Amaury Guichon assigns an exercise with oozing elements.

1.title: EN - School of Chocolate [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Chocolate Hanging by a Thread
1.plot: After a controversial win in the pastry round, the students break into teams of two for a gravity-defying chocolate showpiece challenge.

1.title: EN - School of Chocolate [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Bittersweet Surprises
1.plot: A pastry challenge divides the class in two after Amaury shows his pupils how to form exquisite flower petals and a functional chocolate hinge.

1.title: EN - School of Chocolate [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Flying Chocolate
1.plot: When teams push their skills to new heights to craft kid-friendly showpieces, unfamiliar tools send chocolate flying — and stress skyrocketing.

1.title: EN - School of Chocolate [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Give Me Some Sugar
1.plot: Amaury creates a mind-blowing sugar dome with plastic wrap, a bucket and trapped air. Can the chefs use the technique for their own winning sweets?

meta.plot: Unwrap the real stories behind these iconic Christmas blockbusters, thanks to insider interviews and behind-the-scenes peeks.

1.title: EN - The Holiday Movies That Made Us [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Elf
1.plot: Despite its gifted cast and wonderland of effects, this endearing Christmas comedy is sold short by the studio — till it scores big with moviegoers.

1.title: EN - The Holiday Movies That Made Us [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Nightmare Before Christmas
1.plot: The unlikely holiday classic, and stop-motion first, comes to ghoulish life with persistent vision — and nimble work by a ragtag bunch of misfits.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Before Sam and Dean, there were their parents, John and Mary. This is the untold love story of how they met and put it all on the line to save the entire world.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E02 - Teach Your Children Well
1.plot: John and Millie are on different pages about his new interest in hunting and Ada tries to bridge the gap. Mary follows a trail from her father that points to the disappearance of a teenage boy in Topeka. Meanwhile, Carlos has a heart to heart with Mary as Latika dives into her books to identify the monster.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E03 - You're Lost Little Girl
1.plot: When Mary's next-door neighbor mysteriously goes missing, she and John start digging into the disappearance. During their investigation, John unexpectedly reunites with someone from his past. Carlos and Ada bond as they stakeout a potential lead for the demon's partner. Meanwhile, Latika taps into old folklore passed down from her family in hopes it helps Mary and John.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E04 - Masters of War
1.plot: After the details of a veteran's death don't add up, Carlos brings everyone in to investigate and he shares a detail about his past that makes John see him in a new light. Mary finds an unexpected ally who has been hot on the trail of this monster and Latika tries to help Mary heal and find closure with someone she lost. Meanwhile, John's habit of running headfirst into danger leaves Millie worried for her son.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E06 - Art of Dying
1.plot: Mary gets a call from an old family friend who's looking for some help but when the team arrives, they learn that some crucial details were left out.  While Latika struggles with being a Hunter and questions her future with it, John's eagerness, and commitment to the Hunt worries Mary. Carlos finds himself in a situation he's never experienced before and doesn't know what to do with himself.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E07 - Reflections
1.plot: The Hunt heats up and Mary and John find trails that lead back to their fathers. Carlos helps Mary investigate where the Akrida might be hiding but they discover more than they bargained for. Meanwhile, Millie steps in to help Latika, Ada, and John to decipher notes left behind and they stumble upon a way to get some answers.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E08 - Hang On to Your Life
1.plot: With some intense emotions still lingering after their high stakes recovery mission, Mary and John stay close to home to watch over a newly returned Samuel Campbell. When Latika and Carlos split off to investigate the death of a musician, Carlos is forced to face a part of his past he has been avoiding. Millie spends time helping Samuel recover from his injuries and learns a little more about the Men of Letters.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E09 - Cast Your Fate to the Wind
1.plot: When Vampires make their way into Lawrence, Carlos corrals the gang to find out why. Latika's weeks of sorting through the Men of Letters clubhouse provides vital information when John gets a scary glimpse into the future and enlists Millie's help with his plan. Meanwhile, Mary struggles with the tedious balance between feelings and action when it comes to John.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E10 - Suspicious Minds
1.plot: While Carlos talks through a problem in his personal life, it gives Latika a new idea about how to find the Akrida Queen. Millie's new security system for the Clubhouse proves helpful when Mary and John find an unexpected guest inside. Meanwhile, Latika's idea brings her and Carlos face to face with an unexpected ally.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E11 - You've Got a Friend
1.plot: In the aftermath of the fight with Golem, Carlos, Mary and Latika are cleaning the clubhouse when they hear a noise from outside. They creep out to investigate and spot a figure but can't quite make it out until it turns, and they are shocked to see John standing before them, covered in blood.  Meanwhile, Carlos and Latika set out in search of something important.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E12 - The Tears of a Clown
1.plot: Mary and John's tense discussion is interrupted when Carlos and Latika arrive to discuss a mystery involving a creepy clown. Meanwhile, Ada makes an interesting discovery.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E13 - Hey, That's No Way to Say Goodbye
1.plot: John receives a message from a mysterious stranger. Meanwhile, Carlos, Latika and Ada work together to find answers, but time is running out. Lastly, Mary and John have a warm but awkward reunion. There is a lot to unpack, but they realize this isn't the time or place.

meta.plot: Before Sam and Dean, there was John and Mary. Told from the perspective of narrator Dean Winchester, this is the epic, untold love story of how John met Mary, and how they put it all on the line to not only save their love, but the entire world.
Though claims of extraterrestrial encounters have long been dismissed, many believe the existence of UFOs is not just likely, but a certainty.

1.title: EN - Top Secret UFO Projects Declassified [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Project Blue Book Unknown
1.plot: During the Cold War Project Blue Book came into being – aimed at gathering and analysing UFO observations. To this day, many cases still raise unanswered questions.

1.title: EN - Top Secret UFO Projects Declassified [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The White House Cover Up
1.plot: What’s the truth of the organisation known as the MJ-12, an alleged secret committee of elite experts rumoured to have included an American President? Was its establishment related to the mysterious events over Roswell and could it still be active today?

1.title: EN - Top Secret UFO Projects Declassified [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Code Name Aurora
1.plot: Phillip J. Corso claims that the US army possesses at least one crashed extra-terrestrial craft, what secrets are to be found behind the veil of the mysterious Project Aurora?

1.title: EN - Top Secret UFO Projects Declassified [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Hacked and Leaked
1.plot: This episode follows the stories of American UFO witnesses Betty Cash and Vickie Landrum, Scottish hacker Gary McKinnon, former musician Tom Delonge and John Podesta.

1.title: EN - Top Secret UFO Projects Declassified [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Secret Soviet UFO Research
1.plot: The Petrozavodsk incident of 1977 was the key moment which determined the official Soviet response to the UFO phenomenon. The sighting of unknown objects in the skies above the Russian city led to the creation of two special boards: scientific and military. In 1987, a military helicopter pursues an unknown object which fits the description of the “TIC-TAC” UFO.

1.title: EN - Top Secret UFO Projects Declassified [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - After Disclosure
1.plot: What do we know about the intentions of UFOs? Answers might be found in an incident that took place in the African city of Ruwa, where an unknown vehicle landed on the property of a school and whose crew members communicated telepathically with the local children.

meta.plot: Heinous criminals have avoided capture despite massive rewards and global investigations. This docuseries profiles some of the world’s most wanted.

1.title: EN - World's Most Wanted [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada Garcia: The Head of the Sinaloa Cartel
1.plot: Even after son Vicente and top lieutenant El Chapo are arrested, reputed Sinaloa Cartel chieftain El Mayo is suspected of ruling his region of Mexico.

1.title: EN - World's Most Wanted [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Félicien Kabuga: The Financer of the Genocide in Rwanda
1.plot: Accused of financing the Rwandan genocide in the '90s, Félicien Kabuga spends decades eluding authorities.

1.title: EN - World's Most Wanted [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Samantha Lewthwaite: The White Widow
1.plot: A Muslim convert born in the UK, Samantha Lewthwaite denounces the 7/7 London subway attack. Later, she's suspected of masterminding acts of terror.

1.title: EN - World's Most Wanted [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Semion Mogilevich: The Russian Mafia Boss
1.plot: Semion Mogilevich, who's believed to be the "boss of bosses" in the Russian mob, is run out of Hungary and back to Russia. He remains powerful and free.

1.title: EN - World's Most Wanted [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Matteo Messina Denaro: Cosa Nostra's Last Godfather
1.plot: Suspected of orchestrating the murders of two judges and a series of terror attacks in 1993, Matteo Messina Denaro is still a fugitive at large.

meta.plot: In this funny, heartfelt and moving docuseries, real people unpack the fascinating and quirky stories around their most meaningful pieces of clothing.

1.title: EN - Worn Stories [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Community
1.plot: Clothing — or the lack thereof — can bring people together, whether they're celebrating a life, shining on the dance floor or woodworking in the nude.

1.title: EN - Worn Stories [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Lost and Found
1.plot: Loss hurts — and inspires. A codpiece is revived as a career rebounds. A stray coat leads to adventure while airbrushed tees memorialize the dead.

1.title: EN - Worn Stories [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Beginnings
1.plot: Author Emily Spivack rediscovers the first thing she ever wore, but that's just the start of a look at origin stories and how clothing shapes a life.

1.title: EN - Worn Stories [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Growing Up
1.plot: Gender-neutral b'nai mitzvah garb, football pants worn by a Kurdish American player, a sexy jockstrap for a writer — there's no one way to grow up.

1.title: EN - Worn Stories [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Uniform
1.plot: Protective, practical uniforms find new uses when a crossing guard refuses to be defined, an artist enjoys erasure, and a lawmaker proudly stands out.

1.title: EN - Worn Stories [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Chance
1.plot: Let it ride. These ladies are betting big in Las Vegas, tackling pro wrestling, showcasing Black nightlife and even glittering onstage as Charo.

1.title: EN - Worn Stories [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Survival
1.plot: Designer leggings and a hoodie can be a matter of life and death when a creative recalls LA's plague years and a dad hunts for signs of his dead son.

1.title: EN - Worn Stories [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Love
1.plot: A Vegas singer embraces his inner Elvis, boots bring back a kicked-to-the-curb love, and a quilt patches up a family. Love is all sewn up in our duds.

meta.plot: Comedian Oliver Polak gets to know celebrities at some of their favorite spots before roasting them with good-natured stand-up sets.

1.title: EN - Your Life is a Joke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Christian Ulmen
1.plot: Oliver accompanies Christian Ulmen to a few of his favorite locales, including a hardware store and a car wash. Afterward, the jokes fly onstage.

1.title: EN - Your Life is a Joke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Nura
1.plot: Oliver explores Berlin with rapper Nura, who brings the comedian to some of her top haunts, including a roller-skating rink and a nail salon.

1.title: EN - Your Life is a Joke [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Jennifer Weist
1.plot: Rock star Jennifer Weist hits the gym, eats ice cream and opens up about coming of age in the music world. Later, an inspired Oliver does stand-up.

1.title: FR - How to Die Alone - S01E01 - Stop Living
1.plot: When Mel's best friend deserts her on her birthday, she tries to salvage the day with a gift that knocks her out and wakes her up.

1.title: FR - How to Die Alone - S01E02 - Lie and Deny
1.plot: Still in pain from her accident, Mel and Rory go on a prescription drug hunt in the airport's underbelly.

1.title: FR - How to Die Alone - S01E03 - Burn Bridges
1.plot: A professional development classroom exercise reveals to Mel why and who has been holding her back.

1.title: FR - How to Die Alone - S01E04 - Settle
1.plot: When Mel finds herself stuck between Alex's past, present and future, it drives her into the arms of a coworker.

1.plot: Stepping into Peride's shoes, Esra sets out with Ahmet to correct the course of history, but gets on Halit and George's radar.

1.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S01E03 - Secret
1.plot: As the political stakes rise, Ahmet finds a notebook in the room occupied by Fahrettin, who informs Esra of George's sinister plan for Istanbul.

1.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S01E04 - Awol
1.plot: Halit confronts Esra about her plans with Fahrettin. Esra slips a note to Mustafa Kemal, but her ruse puts others in jeopardy.

1.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S01E05 - What Goes Around Comes Around
1.plot: Dimitri warns Ahmet about the perils of meddling with the past. As Leyla's fate hangs by a thread, Esra discovers Halit's true motives.

1.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S01E06 - Life or Death
1.plot: With Ahmet's fate hinging on Halit's recovery, Esra uses Dimitri's key to travel in time and keeps encountering Halit under unexpected circumstances.

1.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S01E07 - Confrontation
1.plot: A ring found near Peride's body sheds new light on the identity of her real killer. George makes a treacherous deal with Sonya and closes in on Halit.

1.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S01E08 - Hairspring
1.plot: Sonya finds a key to changing the past. After confronting Reşat, Esra devises a plan to expose George's scheme and foil a wider conspiracy.

2.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: An unwelcome visitor arrives at present-day Pera Palace and Ahmet takes matters into his own hands. Esra begins her search for her biological mother.

2.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Emotions run high as Esra is unexpectedly reunited with Halit in 1941, but suspicions arise as he reveals what he is truly capable of.

2.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Ahmet and Esra both find themselves taking on new jobs to open a few doors, while an old acquaintance of Halit jeopardizes the time passage.

2.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: An unlikely friendship forms between Esra and a new colleague. Now they must put their journalistic skills to work to uncover some shocking truths.

2.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Trust between Esra and Halit continues to split at the seams when she discovers an incriminating letter in his coat pocket.

2.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: The search for Halime's baby takes Esra to another time, but this path leads her right into harm's way. Will she be able to dance her way out of it?

2.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: Esra returns to 1941 to find that she has been gone far longer than expected. Ahmet's mind spirals into a deteriorated state.

2.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: After Esra discovers an important connection among the captured women, she devises a plot to take down Mümtaz's diabolical schemes once and for all.

1.title: FR - Pourquoi pas Evans ? - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Along the rugged Welsh coastline, Bobby Jones finds a dying man at the bottom of the cliffs. As Bobby tries to ease his final moments, the dying man utters a mysterious question.

1.title: FR - Pourquoi pas Evans ? - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Following a shocking death thought to be suicide, Bobby and Frankie are convinced it was murder. Together, they hatch a plan to infiltrate Frankie into the home of their prime suspect.

1.title: FR - Pourquoi pas Evans ? - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: As Frankie and Bobby dig deeper, they begin to uncover a dark conspiracy. Will they finally find the meaning behind that fateful question?

meta.plot: Sosuke Kaburaya is a detective struggling to make ends meet. While on a case, he happens upon Sara da Odin, a princess from another world who wields magical powers. Sara quickly adjusts to modern Japanese life as Livia de Udis, a knight from Sara’s kingdom, arrives to find her. Soon enough, both Sara and Livia’s positivity begins to rub off on Sōsuke and the neighborhood’s cast of characters.

1.title: EN - A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Awaiting Kirin (From Another World)
1.plot: Sosuke is a hardworking private detective who's down on his luck, but he'll be working even harder after he catches an (un)lucky break—an otherworldly princess who falls from the sky and takes an interest in his occupation.

1.title: EN - A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Homeless Lady Knight / First Job
1.plot: Sara begins helping Sosuke with his detective work, and Livia is still making the best of life on the street while looking for her princess. It's just a shame that her best, well, isn't very good.

1.title: EN - A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Homeless Gourmet
1.plot: Livia faces a desperate struggle concerning her diet. A certain organization also takes an interest in her. But surely they can't win her over with the promise of food and housing... can they?

1.title: EN - A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Princess and Skateboards / Halloween in Gifu
1.plot: Sara takes an interest in all things preteen on Earth, while Sosuke begins to wonder what exactly she's doing on Earth. But the case at hand comes first! Can he puzzle out both at the same time?

1.title: EN - A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Homeless Lady Knight Resets / The Princess and Karaoke Cafés
1.plot: Sosuke introduces Sara to the wonders of breakfast in Gifu, along with a spot of karaoke. Meanwhile, Livia discovers the refreshing power of a good public bath... that is, before she gets caught up in another unsavory job.

1.title: EN - A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Religious Leader and the Savior / The Mooching Lady Knight / The Lady Knight Joins a Band
1.plot: Noa continues her devout pursuit of Livia's holy body with perfectly wholesome interests at heart. Meanwhile, Puriketsu continues to dream of making it big with a band. Is there a way Livia might be able to help?

1.title: EN - A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Princess and the Kotatsu / The Girl From Another World and Family Register Issues / The Princess and Horses
1.plot: As the weather turns chilly, Sosuke introduces Sara to a special wintertime treat. Then they're off on case that's going to take them in circles and give them a run for their money, you could say.

1.title: EN - A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Princess and the Father / The Princess and Her Friend / Little Miss Religious Leader Eats Grasshoppers / The Princess and Age / The Loner Middle Schooler
1.plot: Sosuke's quest to get Sara into school continues. The question is how to get a princess from another world the paperwork she needs, and Sosuke may have just the family connection to get the job done.

1.title: EN - A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Demon Lord's Descendant Makes Her Grade School Debut / Detective Awakening
1.plot: It's Sara's first day at school, and she's bound to make a big impression—for better or worse. Meanwhile, Yuna adjusts to life at her new middle school.

1.title: EN - A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Multiplying Princesses / Gambler Lady Knight / Friendship Between Girls (LOL)
1.plot: Sara teaches multiple girls about being princesses, multiple women are now vying for Sosuke's hand in marriage (unbeknownst to him), and Livia tries multiple ways to make a living gambling.

1.title: EN - A Salad Bowl of Eccentrics [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Christmas in Gifu / The Princess and the Aquarium / The Wicked Women's Challenge / A Reunion Under the Bridge
1.plot: Sara gets to enjoy her winter break, including (way too many) Christmas parties, a special gift from Livia, and a big trip to the aquarium. Meanwhile, Livia meets up with an old friend, and Brenda prepares for Valentine's Day.

meta.plot:
The city's academies are divided into their own districts and are considered mostly independent.

The General Student Council acts as a governing board to manage the academies as a whole. However, the group's ability to govern has come to a halt since the mysterious disappearance of the General Student Council president. Countless issues have begun to surface throughout Kivotos in the absence of the president's leadership.

To avoid disaster, the General Student Council requests assistance from the Federal Investigation Club, otherwise known as Schale. In fact, Schale is the city's newest club and the last to be approved before the president's disappearance.

To accomplish its task, Schale relies on the guidance of a Sensei who can help them resolve the incidents around Kivotos.

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Abydos High School Foreclosure Task Force
1.plot: There are only five students in the whole school. Abydos High School, surrounded by desert, is on the verge of closure. To fight against this, the 5 of them are busy working as a "task force." One day, Shiroko, a student, meets an adult. He was a "Sensei" dispatched by the Federal Student Council.

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - I Will Not Accept You!
1.plot: After meeting Sensei, the Task Force begins to see hope for preventing the closure of their school. They have even defeated the approaching Helmet Gang, and their hopes are gradually growing. However, only one of them, Serika, seems unable to accept her teacher. Then danger approaches her?!

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Leave It to Problem Solver 68!
1.plot: The Task Force and Sensei try to solve the problem at hand, but the amount of debt is so huge that they sigh. Unable to come up with a solution, they go into a ramen shop and hit it off with a group of girls who call themselves "Problem Solver 68," a group of outlaws. The next day, however, "Problem Solver 68" begins to attack Abydos High School?!

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Masked Swimsuit Gang⭐︎
1.plot: The Abydos Task Force heads to the "Black Market," a famously lawless area, in pursuit of clues about the Helmet Gang that attacked them. While investigating with "Hifumi," a girl from Trinity General School that they happened to meet, they discover a possibility that the repaid money was flowing into a black market. There, Shiroko suddenly shouts, "We're gonna rob the bank!"

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - We're Not Their Friends!
1.plot: After failing their attack on Abydos, Problem Solver 68 are currently preparing for their next move. On the other hand, their leader, Aru, is struggling with the difference between her ideal and reality. Meanwhile, while Shiroko and her team are running away from Black Market, they decide to leave the large sum of money they inadvertently acquired during their heist. During that time, something big happened at Serika's part-time restaurant, Shiba Seki Ramen.

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Gehenna Prefect Team
1.plot: Shiroko and the others were confronted by Gehenna Academy's Prefect Team. Their target was Problem Solver 68, a group of problem children at the same school. The Prefect Team demanded they be extradited, but the Task Force refused. Problem Solver 68, who blew up Shiba Seki Ramen, could not be handed over that easily. In the face of the Prefect Team, the Task Force and Problem Solver 68 team up to take action.

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - I Have to Move Forward
1.plot: After the battle with the Prefect Team and saying goodbye to Problem Solver 68, daily life finally returned to Abydos. Then, the girls of the Task Force visit the owner of Shiba Seki Ramen and learn a shocking truth. Meanwhile, Hoshino is lost in thought in a different way than usual.

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - A Secret
1.plot: At Hoshino's suggestion, the Task Force and Sensei decide to go to the aquarium. The girls spend a peaceful time together, as if the days of battle up to that point had been a lie. Hoshino seemed to enjoy herself as much as the others, but Shiroko felt a slight sense of discomfort. Determined, she took a certain action.

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Into the Abydos Desert
1.plot: The Task Force learns that Abydos land does not belong to Abydos. What is the current owner of the land, Kaiser Corporation, up to? To find out, Shiroko and the others head to the Abydos Desert.

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Only Place That Has Meaning
1.plot: The letter left by Hoshino describes her past and her feelings. Shiroko runs out of the school without thinking, but at that moment, Kaiser Corporation attacks Abydos High School. When the Task Force finds itself in a tight spot due to the sudden attack, the "girls" appear before them.

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Because She Is My Student
1.plot: Sensei has a meeting with Black Suit face-to-face. Black Suit reveals that, just like Sensei, he isn't from Kivotos but is part of an organization called Gematria that researches and discovers Kivotos' secrets. Black Suit invites Sensei to join Gematria, but he refuses. He wants to save Hoshino, who is still his student since he never signed and approved her withdrawal letter. Despite his confusion about why Sensei cares about the students, Black Suit gives up and tells Sensei that Hoshino is being held at the Kaiser PMC base.

1.title: EN - Blue Archive the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - I'm Home
1.plot: The Abydos Task Force and Sensei arrived at the desert with their hearts full. Meanwhile, Hoshino, who is still in captivity, has a certain thought in her mind. The final battle for their school and future comes to a close.

meta.plot: Alya is a transfer student enjoying popularity at her new high school, often sporting a cold shoulder while earning high marks in class. She ignores her nerdy classmate, Kuze Masachika, except for when she blurts out a flirtatious line to him in Russian. Little does she know, Kuze understands Russian, though he pretends not to. Let’s see where this wacky love story takes them!

1.title: EN - Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Alya Hides Her Feelings in Russian
1.plot: Alisa Mikhailovna Kujo, also known as Alya, is the ice queen sitting atop the social hierarchy of Seirei Academy. Despite her cold demeanor, she often flirts with her crush, but only in Russian. However, he may know more than he lets on.

1.title: EN - Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - So Much For Childhood Friends
1.plot: Alya runs into Masachika and Suou while they're out shopping and continues to question the nature of their relationship. Suou takes the opportunity to invite Alya out to a super spicy ramen restaurant.

1.title: EN - Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - And So They Met
1.plot: While spending some time with her sister, Alya recounts how she met Masachika and began to think highly of him despite his slacker status. Later, Masha gets to meet him in person when he helps out the student council.

1.title: EN - Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - An Outpouring of Emotion
1.plot: Alya is sent by the student council to mediate a conflict between the soccer and baseball teams about the use of the school fields. When the conflict comes to a standstill, Masachika saves the day and makes an important promise to Alya.

1.title: EN - Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Different People, Common Undercurrent
1.plot: Masachika returns home after mulling over Alya's confession. The next day, he states his intentions to make Alya student council president and finds himself increasingly distracted by Alya despite his best efforts.

1.title: EN - Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - A Kiss of the Indirect Variety
1.plot: Yuki uses a student council task as an excuse to get Alya alone and discuss how they truly feel about Masachika. When Masachika uses time alone together to be all work and no play, Alya decides to force a romantic moment.

1.title: EN - Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - A Storm Arrives
1.plot: Ayano confronts Masachika about his intentions to run against Yuki in the upcoming election. The student council throw a welcome party for their two new members where Masachika and Masha discuss their more hidden natures.

1.title: EN - Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Student Congress
1.plot: The student congress arrives and Alya finds herself wrapped up in a shocking amount of political intrigue and maneuvers. Will her teamwork and preparation with Masachika be enough to win them the day?

1.title: EN - Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Rom-commy With a Chance of Hypnosis
1.plot: Masachika tries to capitalize on their victory in the congress, but Alya has some conflicting thoughts about benefitting from Taniyama being ridiculed. A confiscated book leads to some shenanigans among the student council members.

1.title: EN - Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Birthday Party, Much Belated
1.plot: Masachika is having trouble studying for exams until Alya decides to wager a favor on how well he does. When Alya discovers she wasn't invited to celebrate Masachika's birthday, she spends several days questioning just how close they actually are.

1.title: EN - Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - An Unexpected Curtain-Raiser
1.plot: The unexpected encounter at the parent-teacher meetings leaves Masachika weakened and sick, and more importantly, unaware of what's happening at school.

meta.plot: Normally, people choose to become adventurers in their teens. At 30 years old, Rick Gladiator bucks the trend by leaving his job as a guild clerk to become an adventurer. He begins as a novice F-rank with the fighting strength of an S-rank. After two years of brutal training with the continent’s strongest party, Orichalcum Fist, Rick will defeat anyone who underestimates him!

1.title: EN - The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Starting 12 Years Late
1.plot: Rick Gladiatol became an adventurer at the age of thirty. Now, after two years of training, he's taking the test to advance to E-rank. As the exam begins, he wonders if he's done enough to measure up to all the young people testing alongside him.

1.title: EN - The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Number 4242's E-rank Promotion Exam
1.plot: As Rick awaits his initial exam results, Raster, an examiner for the upcoming section, appears. Rick stops him from hitting on Reanette and earns the examiner's hatred. Raster isn't one to be thwarted, and he isn't called the F-rank Crusher for nothing.

1.title: EN - The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Super First-Rate Elite vs an F-Rank Ossan
1.plot: Rick begins his mock battle with the F-rank Crusher, Raster Diarmut. Raster thinks the gap in ability between him, a genius, and Rick, a late-starting newbie, is all too clear. But as the battle progresses, Rick's training begins to show through.

1.title: EN - The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Ossan Becomes an Adventurer
1.plot: As Rick waits for his test results, memories flood his mind. As a boy, he'd dreamed of being an adventurer, but the older he got, the more distant the dream became. He set it aside and began work at a Guild. Then, Rick met a certain S-rank adventurer.

1.title: EN - The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Ossan, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party
1.plot: Laurotte asks Rick if he can meet Orichalcum Fist. Rick agrees, but under certain conditions. After warming to Laurotte, Broughston asks him to gather intel to help the party reach their goal. A tip from him sends Rick and the others to a northern town.

1.title: EN - The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The King of Fists Elimination Tournament
1.plot: Rick and the others head to Heractopia to look for information on the Six Jewels. A parade for an upcoming tournament makes them realize that what they seek might be closer than they think, but there's only one way to know for sure. Enter the tournament!

1.title: EN - The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Ossan, the Fastest Preliminaries Qualifier in History
1.plot: Angelica, Rick, and Broughston all make it through the preliminaries, but the two men do it at an unheard of speed. Rick meets a tournament sponsor who says he's close to Angelica, but when Rick mentions him, Angelica's expression turns dark. (Subs Flix_)

1.title: EN - The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Scales of the Heart
1.plot: Angelica tries to run from her brutal training. Rick empathizes and shares something Broughston once told him. After her training, Angelica faces her final block match. Will she break through the qualifiers? The King of Fists Tournament is about to begin.

1.title: EN - The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Perfect Prodigy, Born with Absolutely Everything
1.plot: Angelica strikes at Geith using the techniques she's learned in her training. Rick and the others watch closely as she makes use of what they've taught her. Just when it looks like Angelica is about to win, Geith rallies. But Anglica isn't one to give up. (Subs Flix_)

1.title: EN - The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Strongest Pugilist in History
1.plot: The second semi-final match pits Kelvin against Broughston. Kelvin heads out of town to prepare. He spots Rick and presses him for a sparring match. After seeing Rick's skills, Kelvin opens up to Rick about his dreams and what his strength has cost him. (Azanime)

meta.plot: Set between the Kamakura and Muromachi periods, during the Kenmu Restoration, the story follows the tale of Hojo Tokiyuki, a boy on the run after his family is overthrown by Ashikaga Takauji. With his only allies being a shady priest and his followers, the young lord must seek revenge and regain his glory, with his only weapon: a superhuman ability to flee and hide.

1.title: EN - The Elusive Samurai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - May 22nd
1.plot: The year is 1333, Kamakura. Tokiyuki Hojo, the rightful heir to the regent who rules the Kamakura shogunate, is a kind boy with a heart of gold who dislikes conflict – even though he’s the son of a warrior.

1.title: EN - The Elusive Samurai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Gentle Uncle
1.plot: Takauji Ashikaga, once considered the guardian of the Kamakura shogunate, stages a rebellion that led to its quick destruction. Tokiyuki’s older brother, Kunitoki, successfully evades the eyes of the warriors loyal to Takauji, and he is placed under the care of their uncle, Muneshige Godaiin.

1.title: EN - The Elusive Samurai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Forest Inhabited by a God
1.plot: Tokiyuki risks his life and wins a game of tag, defeating the enemy who betrayed his brother. As soon as he arrives in Suwa, Yorishige urges him to begin his lessons and training to take back Kamakura.

1.title: EN - The Elusive Samurai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Sadamune Appears!
1.plot: Tokiyuki spends his days undergoing strenuous training to perfect his sword techniques – something he’s told to do to take back Kamakura for himself. However, everyone was surprised by how weak his swordsmanship was. It turns out that Tokiyuki was much better with another weapon: the bow.

1.title: EN - The Elusive Samurai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Settling the Score! A Dog-Shooting Competition, and Then…
1.plot: Tokiyuki faces off against Sadamune in a dog-shooting competition, even though his opponent excels with the bow and possesses an almost prodigy-like eye for detail. With a large lead in points, Tokiyuki faces defeat as he gets hit.

1.title: EN - The Elusive Samurai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Steal the Imperial Command from Ogasawara's Residence at Night
1.plot: Tokiyuki and Genba sneak into the Ogasawara's residence and successfully infiltrate the warehouse where the Emperor’s Imperial Command is kept. However, Sadamune’s subordinate, Sukefusa Ichikawa, catches on and hears what these two are doing…

1.title: EN - The Elusive Samurai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Children in Winter
1.plot: Tokiyuki reigns in the new year for the first time in Suwa. As the chaos from the downfall lulls throughout the country, skirmishes still break out here and there, and another crisis knocks on Suwa’s doors.

1.title: EN - The Elusive Samurai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - A War of Hide and Seek
EN - The Elusive Samurai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - My Buddha
1.plot: The Elusive Warriors engage in a fierce battle with the Seigi Party, a group spearheaded by Shokan himself. Stuck in a small chamber and faced with opponents wearing armor, Tokiyuki uses the “escape” technique he learned from Fubuki to face off against General Shokan.

meta.plot: Star pitcher Haruka Kiyomine and skilled catcher Kei Kaname were an unstoppable duo—until Kei was hit with a curveball: amnesia. Now they have a second chance to play at a no-name high school with a team of past rivals. Can they overcome Kei’s memory loss and rekindle their baseball dreams? With hilarious hijinks and fierce competition, get ready for a strikeout.

1.title: EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I'll Make You Remember
1.plot: Taro Yamada gave up on baseball and enrolls in a high school with no baseball team. But that's where he finds the strongest battery, Haruka Kiyomine and Kei Kaname. Why would they be here? Besides, Kei has amnesia and forgot about baseball.

1.title: EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Wanna Play Together?
1.plot: Kei still refuses to play baseball, but Haruka manages to lure him out to do batting practice with a certain offer. Aoi Todo and Shunpei Chihaya, who also gave up baseball like Taro did, can't hide their shock to witness their practice.

1.title: EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - So What?
1.plot: To get to know each other, Kei invites Todo and Chihaya to his house. In Kei's room, they find a glove that Haruka has hidden. While each of them faces what they can't let go, the practice game with Teitoku High begins.

1.title: EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - I Won't Hold Back
1.plot: Against Teitoku's batters, Haruka pitches an immaculate inning, before Kotesashi's leadoff, Todo, hits a home run on the very first pitch he faces. As everyone holds their breath, the fated showdown between Haruka, Kei, and Kokuto begins!

1.title: EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - What Led Us to Quit
1.plot: After the game, Teitoku's manager suggests that Haruka, Kei, Todo, and Chihaya should transfer to Teitoku. Kei realizes they lost because of him and hopes to send the others off. Todo and Chihaya consider the offer, but what will their answers be?

1.title: EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - I Do!
1.plot: As he learns more about the rules and tactics of baseball, Kei decides to set his sights on beating Teitoku in a revenge match. However, Todo is reminded why he quit baseball in the first place.

1.title: EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Interesting Guys
1.plot: Todo volunteers to step down from shortstop due to his yips. But inspired by Kei's words, Todo decides to try practicing throwing to first. However, when his training hits a snag, Haruka says something that could ruin everything.

1.title: EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Baseball in 3D Isn't Really My Thing...
1.plot: Now that Todo has overcome his yips, the team are now working on improving Kei's skills. But the overwhelming demands make Kei escape to the rooftop, where he meets Tsuchiya Kazuki, an otaku who likes baseball video games, but hates real-life baseball.

1.title: EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Who Do You Think You're Talking To?
1.plot: Out of curiosity, the team attempts different methods to try and get Kei's memory to come back, but not a single one seems to work. However, the next day...

1.title: EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Can't Run From Them
EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - I'm a Liar
1.plot: Kei's Commander mode comes to an end, and the despondent Kotesashi team allows Hikawa to take the lead. Kei tries to lift the mood of the team, but Chihaya seems to be struggling with a "wall" he has to overcome.

1.title: EN - Oblivion Battery [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Did You Hate It?
1.plot: Top of the ninth inning, the hope of coming back from behind rests on Kei at bat. But the former Commander is overwhelmed by fast pitches by Makita. But words from Haruka reminds Kei of something important.

meta.plot: Lorsque le don naturel d'un écolier pour le golf est découvert accidentellement par une joueuse professionnelle, le garçon se met en tête de devenir le meilleur golfeur du monde.

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E01 - Encountering a Dream
1.plot: Pro golfer Kiria crosses paths with the mischievous Gawain — who possesses an astonishing talent for golf even though he's never played the sport.

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E02 - The Importance of Each Stroke
1.plot: Lost in Tokyo, Gawain has a fateful meeting with a sullen young golfer, who shows him the way to Kiria's home — and a new aspect of golf.

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E03 - Twin Peaks of Talent
1.plot: Gawain learns that making the ball fly isn't enough to become the world's best golfer. He asks Kiria to give him a crash course on putting and iron shots.

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E04 - First Tournament
1.plot: With his new skills, Gawain breezes through the first half of his inaugural tournament. But how will he fare when faced with bad weather conditions?

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E05 - Camelot Academy
1.plot: At Camelot Academy, Gawain meets his new classmates, gifted junior golfers from around the world. Riser, unimpressed by Gawain's size, challenges him.

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E06 - Uncrowned Prince
1.plot: To debut on the golf course, Gawain must win a game against Liebel on the D-level training course. But Liebel behaves strangely during the match play.

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E07 - An Explosive Situation
1.plot: With the Camelot Cup coming up, tensions rise with only seven spots open. Some older schoolmates take aggressive measures to cut the competition.

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E08 - The Tryouts Begin
1.plot: On the day of the tryouts, Gawain is up against Li and Todoin in a spiral course where his usual straight drive won't help. Can he master the slice?

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E09 - Stubbornness and Pride
1.plot: Yumiko struggles with a bunker shot, while Kuromine's gift for seeing snake-like putting lines gets her ahead. Lancelot's unexpected visit causes a stir.

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E10 - Playoffs
1.plot: The final playoff will decide who takes the last spot. But first, Riser and Gawain need to conquer a challenging course — and Kanazono's dirty tricks.

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E11 - A Venerable Visitor
1.plot: Gawain stumbles upon an unassuming salaryman wandering around the school grounds who turns out to be their new coach: Hitomi Katase, a former pro golfer.

1.title: FR - Rising Impact - S01E12 - To the Battlefield!
1.plot: Kuromine challenges transfer student Lancelot, staking her pride as a putter and a spot on the team. The Japan team heads to England for the Camelot Cup.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E01 - Worthy New Opponents
2.plot: Gawain's encounter with Quester from the U.S. team leaves him in shock. Lancelot joins some of his American counterparts for a training session.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E02 - The Door to One's Soul
2.plot: Still rattled from his previous match with Quester, Gawain keeps duffing his shots. While he deals with his mental block, Platalissa confides in him.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E03 - Camelot Cup Competition!
2.plot: A surprise change to the U.K. team's order of play disrupts Ms. Aria's strategy for the Japan team, but Gawain and Lancelot rise to the challenge.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E04 - An Awakened Power
2.plot: As the pairs take on increasingly tricky courses, Gawain struggles with his control and strength — until he begins to see the sparks of a new power.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E05 - The Brits Go Into Overdrive
2.plot: Quester begins to lose confidence after witnessing Gawain's incredible growth. After coasting in the first half, Sfida and Ice turn the heat up.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E06 - The Way to Victory
2.plot: Faced with the final two holes, the U.K. and U.S. teams go all out. Will Gawain and Lancelot be able to clinch victory for the Japan team?

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E07 - The Dark Nobleman
2.plot: While Liebel and Todoin brood over their poor performance against Tristan, the other players gear up for the Camelot Cup's main event: individual matches.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E08 - Monsters
2.plot: The Brits display their monstrous talent: Percival's impressive backswing and Tristan's incredible power and precision fire up Gawain and Lancelot.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E09 - An Approaching Destiny
2.plot: As the competition grows more heated and the young golfers battle it out on the fairways, Gawain's Gift attracts a mysterious man's attention.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E10 - Heart of Glass
2.plot: Wanglian's mastery over turbulent winds stuns everyone. Meanwhile, Lancelot's confidence starts to shatter as he loses control of his strokes.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E11 - Awaken!
2.plot: Gawain enters an injury-induced trance after being hit by Percival's ball, and a profound power emerges from him. Lancelot continues to falter.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E12 - A Contest of Gift
2.plot: Thanks to Gawain's words, Lancelot gets back his confidence — and his Gift. Gawain's uncanny performance continues and catches Tristan's attention.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E13 - To the Top
2.plot: Finding himself shaken by Lancelot and Gawain's skills, Tristan reevaluates his motivations. Gawain refuses to back down despite his worsening injury.

2.title: FR - Rising Impact - S02E14 - See You Again!
2.plot: The Camelot Cup draws to a close, and the young golfers reflect on their results. At the hospital, Gawain gets an intriguing invite from Arthur.
