1.plot: While Katie and Andy head out on a mission to save the camp, Lindsay follows a hot tip, and Donna approaches Victor with a surprising request.

1.title: FR - Wet Hot American Summer: Ten Years Later - S01E04 - Lunch
1.plot: A newcomer shakes up the chemistry at camp. Mitch reaches out to an old friend for help. Susie's return to the theater creates a stir.

1.title: FR - Wet Hot American Summer: Ten Years Later - S01E05 - King of Camp
1.plot: Andy challenges Deegs to a "King of Camp" showdown, Neil helps Vic prepare for his big moment, and troubling discoveries abound for the Firewood gang.

1.title: FR - Wet Hot American Summer: Ten Years Later - S01E06 - Rain
1.plot: As a storm lashes the camp, tensions between lovers and rivals boil over, and Vic's date takes a turn for the weird.

1.title: FR - Wet Hot American Summer: Ten Years Later - S01E07 - Dance
1.plot: While Mitch's posse scrambles to thwart Reagan's plan, Coop delivers an emotional speech at the dance, and the shocking secret comes to light.

1.title: FR - Wet Hot American Summer: Ten Years Later - S01E08 - End Summer Night's Dream
1.plot: With the clock ticking and their options are running out Camp Firewood family braces for disaster. But there are more surprises in store.

1.title: FR - Strike - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Cormoran Strike, an injured war veteran turned PI, and secretary Robin Ellacott seek the truth surrounding the mysterious death of supermodel Lula Landry.

1.title: FR - Strike - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Strike makes a breakthrough. Robin is offered a permanent job in HR but is reluctant to take it.

1.title: FR - Strike - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Long-buried secrets are revealed, putting Strike and Robin in danger as they close in the killer.

2.title: FR - Strike - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: War veteran turned private investigator Cormoran Strike investigates the disappearance of a provocative author. Robin is caught between Strike and Matthew's hopes.

2.title: FR - Strike - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Delving deeper into the hidden meanings and concealed secrets of Bombyx Mori, Strike and Robin scour all corners of London's literary world to unmask the killer.

3.title: FR - Strike - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: A dismembered leg sent to Strike's office sends both his and Robin's lives into disarray, forcing them to confront spectres from their pasts.

3.title: FR - Strike - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: Strike and Robin's partnership reaches breaking point as Robin's wedding approaches, and they disagree about how to ensnare a man who abuses children.

4.title: FR - Strike - S04E01 - Episode 1
4.plot: Cormoran Strike and Robin Ellacott are at odds following Robin’s wedding to Matthew, but there’s no time to mull over the new distance within their professional relationship, as a frightening visit from a potential client puts a new case on the table - and Robin and Strike set to work looking into reports of a strangled child.

4.title: FR - Strike - S04E02 - Episode 2
4.plot: A startling discovery seems to confirm the story of the strangled child, but the team are forced to leave the scene before they can properly investigate. Fearing their witness is in danger, they redouble their efforts to find him.

4.title: FR - Strike - S04E03 - Episode 3
4.plot: Robin discovers a startling truth close to home. The government minister’s blackmailer becomes the prime suspect in the case, but Robin and Strike believe there was an accomplice.

4.title: FR - Strike - S04E04 - Episode 4
4.plot: Robin admits the truth to Strike, and a valuable clue helps them solve the case. Season finale.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E01 - Episode 1
5.plot: Strike is approached by a woman asking for help to find her mother, Margot Bamborough, who went missing in 1974 when a psychopathic serial killer stalked the streets.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E02 - Episode 2
5.plot: The investigation takes a dangerous turn as a disturbing piece of evidence leads Robin and Strike into London’s underworld. Robin risks her life by pursuing a vicious suspect.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E03 - Episode 3
5.plot: Spurred on by the father of a young woman who also went missing in the 1970s, the detectives attempt to outwit an incarcerated serial killer who may hold the key to the case.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E04 - Episode 4
5.plot: Strike realises that Margot’s killer is responsible for many other murders that have gone undetected, and lays a trap.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E01 - Episode 1
6.plot: Edie Ledwell, the co-creator of a cult TV cartoon, The Ink Black Heart, is being harassed by an online figure, Anomie. She asks Robin to uncover Anomie's true identity.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E02 - Episode 2
6.plot: Robin, Strike and Barclay all take risks to further the investigation now that they think Anomie probably killed Edie Ledwell. Strike receives an unexpected and unwelcome visitor.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E03 - Episode 3
6.plot: Robin and Strike make a major breakthrough, having eliminated several suspects. Robin's cover is blown, and Strike stays the night at her new flat. Meanwhile, Anomie claims another two victims.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E04 - Episode 4
6.plot: The agency is the target of a devastating attack. Strike figures out who killed Edie, and having secured proof, Robin puts herself in danger in order to save lives.

meta.plot: A war veteran turned private detective operates out of a tiny office in London’s Denmark Street. Although wounded both physically and psychologically, his unique insight and background as a military police investigator prove crucial in solving complex crimes that have baffled the police. Based on the bestselling novels written by J.K. Rowling under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith.
Old-school police detective Pierre Niemans and his former student Camille Delaunay tackle complex, brutal murder cases.

1.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S01E01 - The Last Hunt (1)
1.plot: A mutilated corpse is found during a forest hunting party and it seems the victim was the heir to a family fortune. As Niemans and Camille question his immediate circle, his sister is also targeted.

1.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S01E02 - The Last Hunt (2)
1.plot: Niemans and Camille are put on the track of a curse that is rumoured to be placed on the sons of the Von Geyersberg family. But are the rich clan really the victims or is there a killer among them?

1.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S01E03 - The Day of the Ashes (1)
1.plot: In a wine-growing region at harvest time, a battered corpse is discovered under rubble when a vault collapses during the renovation of a chapel, destroying a fresco. Was it an accident or foul play?

1.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S01E04 - The Day of the Ashes (2)
1.plot: When Niemans obtains X-ray images of the damaged frescos, they provide further insight into the case, but does a missing fragment from the biblical scenes portrayed hold the key to the killer?

1.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S01E05 - The Children's Crusade (1)
1.plot: When two men discover the severed hand of a child, Niemans and Camille find the local police distracted by the case of a serial killer armed with a rifle. Can they find clues at a children's home?

1.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S01E06 - The Children's Crusade (2)
1.plot: Two more people are shot dead, in the cemetery: a married couple who took in foster children. But a quotation from an ancient tale about an ill-fated group of children on a memorial provides a clue.

1.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S01E07 - Song of Darkness (1)
1.plot: Niemans witnesses the death of a monk named Brother Guillaume who utters the words 'the sword and the snake' with his dying breath and has the palm of his left hand burned to hide a mysterious tattoo

1.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S01E08 - Song of Darkness (2)
1.plot: It seems the monks believe they have discovered sinister secret messages in the ancient music they've been studying. As Camille and Niemans get closer to the truth, they encounter a satanic sect.

2.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S02E01 - Innocentes (1)
2.plot: A woman is found dead in the steam room of a spa. She looks 20 years younger than she is. Investigations take Niémans and Delaunay to the next village.

2.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S02E02 - Innocentes (2)
2.plot: The body of another spa client is found. What's the connection between the village, the spa director whose clients are being killed and the legends that seem to terrify everyone?

2.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S02E03 - Furta Sacra (1)
2.plot: Niémans and Delaunay explore the dark side of the human soul, along a road dotted with unexplained deaths. Their bond strengthens when Camille's son gets into a desperate situation.

2.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S02E04 - Furta Sacra (2)
2.plot: Camille finds a cryptic note from the killer in her jacket. A second murder occurs while relics are stolen from a nearby town.

2.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S02E05 - Kenbaltyu (1)
2.plot: The body of a black woman is discovered with a hash symbol carved into her forehead. Investigations lead the detectives to a migrant camp.

2.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S02E06 - Kenbaltyu (2)
2.plot: Camille meets the Professor, an authority figure at the camp. When a second body is found, the mystery deepens. A demon myth is terrifying the migrant camp. His calling card is a carved hash symbol.

2.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S02E07 - Lignee de Verre (1)
2.plot: The butler of the Monferville estate finds a 17-year-old in a pitiful condition. The teenager claims to be Herminien, a son of the family who disappeared 6 years ago. Camille is looking for her son Léo.

2.title: FR - The Crimson Rivers - S02E08 - Lignee de Verre (2)
2.plot: Camille suspects her son Léo is pretending to be the missing boy. What a shock when the grieving mother confirms that the boy is Herminien. The case takes a new turn when a DNA test reveals no match between Camille and Léo.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: With the help of Vic and Henry, Longmire investigates a backcountry murder with ties to a tribal family.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E02 - The Dark Road
1.plot: Longmire and his team investigate the death of an exotic dancer with possible Amish roots. Cady's new relationship stirs up controversy.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E03 - A Damn Shame
1.plot: Longmire uncovers long-buried family secrets when he probes the deaths of a man and his award-winning horses in a barn fire.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E04 - The Cancer
1.plot: A fisherman discovers the bodies of two murder victims, including a teen from the Cheyenne reservation.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E05 - Dog Soldier
1.plot: Walt and the team look into the disappearances of several Cheyenne foster children and an unregistered sex offender.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E06 - The Worst Kind of Hunter
1.plot: Walt suspects a bear was baited to fatally attack a released murderer. Branch's retired uncle, a former sheriff, can't resist the lure of law enforcement.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E07 - 8 Seconds
1.plot: A wealthy beer distributor is brutally assaulted for a seemingly worthless painting; Vic's husband is jealous of her relationship with Walt; Branch's father uncovers information damaging to Walt's campaign.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E08 - An Incredibly Beautiful Thing
1.plot: Henry uses his tracking abilities to locate an unstable young woman who may be involved in the murder of a gas-station owner.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E09 - Dogs, Horses and Indians
1.plot: The Tribal Council president is found dead on county land but it s clear he died elsewhere and there is soon a large suspect list. Walt deals with feelings of betrayal when he uncovers Cady and Branch s affair.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E10 - Unfinished Business
1.plot: In the first-season finale, a teen is murdered after being acquitted of raping a Cheyenne girl. Later, Walt is forced to finally confront his wife’s death.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E01 - Unquiet Mind
2.plot: A prison transfer goes awry and Walt urgently pursues a serial killer and his fellow escapees, who have taken hostages, up a mountain. Facing an impending storm with very limited resources, Walt’s mettle is put to the test and hypothermic hallucinations force him to face his past.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E02 - Carcasses
2.plot: When a body is found in a compost heap, the victim's history of abusive behavior leads to a varied list of suspects. Walt and the team must cross county lines to track down the killer. Branch looks into Cady's abrupt departure from Absaroka.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E03 - Death Came in Like Thunder
2.plot: Walt and the team explore Absaroka's Basque community when a shepherd and his dog are found dead. Branch walks a thin line in his alliance with Jacob Nighthorse. Meanwhile, Cady looks to Detective Fales for answers about her mother's death.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E04 - The Road to Hell
2.plot: A cattle heist sends the team on an urgent search for the missing livestock and driver as well as the thieves. Walt is concerned by Vic's fearful behavior when she receives a mysterious bouquet of flowers.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E05 - Party's Over
2.plot: When a teenage girl is found dead, Walt and the team investigate ties to the illegal sale of prescription drugs. Meanwhile Henry reconnects with an old flame and Cady returns home.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E06 - Tell It Slant
2.plot: Walt is tipped off to the murder of a supposed psychic by the Contrary Warrior, a Cheyenne who does the opposite of what people expect. While deciphering his backwards clues, Walt must also deal with a public debate against Branch.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E07 - Sound and Fury
2.plot: After Henry overhears a disgruntled husband try to order a hit on his wife, Walt and the team must use what little information they have to prevent her murder. Vic is wary when an ex-cop from Philly shows up in Durant.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E08 - The Great Spirit
2.plot: When a wild horse is found dragging a dead body, Walt discovers evidence of an illegal rodeo at a local farm. Detective Fales comes to town to talk to Henry.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E09 - Tuscan Red
2.plot: Following an explosion on the reservation and the discovery of a charred dead body, Walt is bombarded with public confrontation as the Cheyennes blame the blast on gas leaked from fracking by Newett Energy. Meanwhile, Branch reconnects with Cady and uncovers information that could help him in the election.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E10 - Election Day
2.plot: On election day, Walt and Branch aren't thinking about politics when Cady is badly injured by a hit-and-run driver. Vic and Ferg investigate, and Walt has a flashback to when Cady was a little girl.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E11 - Natural Order
2.plot: When a game warden is killed alongside an elk that was poached, Walt discovers a connection to a rare expensive supplement. Walt completes his sacrifice, and Branch closes in on the truth about Cady's accident.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E12 - A Good Death Is Hard to Find
2.plot: Longmire investigates after he receives a safe deposit box from a just-murdered inmate that contains a severed finger that is linked to both a new murder and a 20-year-old armed robbery. At the same time, Vic's paranoia peaks when she suspects she is being stalked, forcing her to confide in Walt.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E13 - Bad Medicine
2.plot: Walt and Branch team up when an apparent suicide is connected to Cady's accident. Meanwhile, Detective Fales returns with warrants, forcing Walt and Henry to face what happened in Denver.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E01 - The White Warrior
3.plot: Walt deals with the aftermath of Henry's arrest and Branch's shooting.The search for the shooter, however, is complicated by Branch's insistence that it was someone known to be already dead.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E02 - Of Children and Travelers
3.plot: An investigation into the murder of a Russian adoptee leads the team into a shady underworld. Henry faces trouble behind bars while Cady attempts to secure him competent legal representation.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E03 - Miss Cheyenne
3.plot: Walt splits his time working on a murder investigation and serving as a judge for a local pageant. Cady hopes an old friend can help with Henry's case.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E04 - In the Pines
3.plot: Walt and the team track missing teenage campers on a leadership trip in the wilderness. Branch continues his unauthorized search for his shooter.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E05 - Wanted Man
3.plot: Walt teams up with Lucian Connally to narrow the field of suspects in his wife's murder. Branch's behavior causes problems.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E06 - Reports of My Death
3.plot: A media frenzy erupts when a long-lost heir who went missing 30 years earlier is found dead. Henry makes a risky decision on his own.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E07 - Population 25
3.plot: Vic's vacation turns deadly after she and Sean are kidnapped following an accident. Walt is forced to make an unusual alliance to rescue the pair.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E08 - Harvest
3.plot: A life insurance policy complicates the investigation into a farmer's apparent murder. Branch and Cady check out a lead in Denver. Vic receives an ultimatum from Sean.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E09 - Counting Coup
3.plot: Walt is seriously concerned by Branch's behavior, but makes a key discovery in the David Ridges case. Henry faces a major setback in his trial. Vic makes an important decision about her future.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E10 - Ashes to Ashes
3.plot: Walt seeks closure in his wife's murder and Henry's case. Branch is suspended but continues to investigate Jacob Nighthorse.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E01 - Down by the River
4.plot: The team struggles with the fallout from Branch's confrontation with Barlow, and Walt's crusade to bring Nighthorse to justice spins out of control.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E02 - War Eagle
4.plot: Walt is forced to split his focus between new evidence in a personal case, and the murder of a caretaker at a former Japanese internment camp.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E03 - High Noon
4.plot: The investigation of Nighthorse heats up, but not in the way that Walt was hoping for. Cady makes a shocking discovery.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E04 - Four Arrows
4.plot: A body found in the luggage of a tour bus further complicates Walt's troubles with Nighthorse. Henry makes a bold move to help a mother and son.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E05 - Help Wanted
4.plot: When the husband of a former soldier is assaulted during an apparent robbery, Walt is drawn into an emotionally charged investigation.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E06 - The Calling Back
4.plot: A young Native American girl is raped on the reservation, which sparks new, volatile tensions between local oil rig workers and the Cheyenne people.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E07 - Highway Robbery
4.plot: A highway robbery sets off an investigation into a strange relationship, while Walt struggles to let go of the past.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E08 - Hector Lives
4.plot: When a former suspect in a rape case ends up dead in another county, Walt and Vic aren't convinced the death is an accident.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E09 - Shotgun
4.plot: Henry's attempt at justice backfires, resulting in new problems for him and a new investigation for Walt.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E10 - What Happens on the Rez...
4.plot: The line between justice and the law gets even blurrier for Henry and Walt as their hunt for a killer intensifies.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E01 - A Fog That Won't Lift
5.plot: A shaky Walt searches for Donna as he and Vic reconstruct what happened in the cabin. Mathias has a deal for Henry. Cady tells Walt about a job offer.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E02 - One Good Memory
5.plot: Henry renegotiates his deal with Mathias. Walt's search for Donna leads to too many suspects. A phone message sends Walt down an unexpected path.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E03 - Chrysalis
5.plot: Walt unravels the puzzling case of a girl and her missing father. Henry helps Cady find a place on the rez. Malachi and Jacob's alliance is weakening.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E04 - The Judas Wolf
5.plot: Walt and Vic investigate the bizarre kidnapping of a despised drug company CEO. Henry and Mathias deal with the ramifications of an overdose.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E05 - Pure Peckinpah
5.plot: Mathias must join forces with Walt after Henry discovers a drug dealer's body. Vic solves her housing problem. Malachi puts a bounty on Hector's head.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E06 - Objection
5.plot: Depositions for Walt's case go badly. Ferg loses confidence in himself. Henry and Vic help lead Walt toward the big boss at Manifest Destinations.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E07 - From This Day Forward
5.plot: When treasure hunters discover a body in a hollow tree, Walt finds a connection to an old case. Cady struggles to help a battered woman on the rez.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E08 - Stand Your Ground
5.plot: Walt looks deeper into the Irish mob. Henry finds the book he needs, while Cady gets legal advice. Malachi and Jacob lob accusations at each other.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E09 - Continual Soiree
5.plot: Walt's obsession with Jacob leads to more tension with Cady. Vic testifies against Gilbert. Walt's anger erupts at the Red Pony.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E10 - The Stuff Dreams Are Made Of
5.plot: Walt gets more bad news from the mayor. Vic does a strange favor. As Walt learns what's behind the lawsuit, Henry and Cady each face tribal rituals.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E01 - The Eagle and the Osprey
6.plot: A bank robbery ends in a shooting, giving Sawyer more leverage against Walt. When Henry goes missing, Cady tells Walt about a disturbing vision.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E02 - Fever
6.plot: While Henry recuperates, Walt investigates the murder of a man whose land is popular with treasure hunters.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E03 - Thank You, Victoria
6.plot: Chance Gilbert's plea appearance takes a dramatic turn that pulls Walt away from his own case and sets him and Vic on the path to a showdown.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E04 - A Thing I'll Never Understand
6.plot: An emotional Vic re-examines her life choices. Henry and Jacob join forces to pursue Malachi. Ferg helps Meg's mother avoid the tribal police.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E05 - Burned Up My Tears
6.plot: As the civil trial begins, things don't look good for Walt -- especially after a murder puts him and Vic under suspicion.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E06 - No Greater Character Endorsement
6.plot: The bizarre death of a drug dealer points to a violent new Hector. Cady tries to help a sick child whose parents don’t trust Western medicine.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E07 - Opiates and Antibiotics
6.plot: Walt wonders if a presumed-dead member of the Irish mob is alive. Mathias questions Cady about Catori. A mobile clinic raises Henry's suspicions.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E08 - Cowboy Bill
6.plot: While Ferg secretly works the Cowboy Bill case, Walt and Vic try to find Shane Muldoon. Cady's office is trashed.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E09 - Running Eagle Challenge
6.plot: Vic gets a surprise visit from her father. An FBI agent helps Walt pin down the mole working with Malachi. A tough race enables Vic to move forward.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E10 - Goodbye Is Always Implied
6.plot: Jacob's troubles escalate at the casino. Walt gets an unexpected visitor. An inevitable confrontation leads to changed lives.

meta.plot: A Wyoming sheriff rebuilds his life and career following the death of his wife. Based on the “Walt Longmire” series of mystery novels written by best-selling author Craig Johnson.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E01 - Might Need a Bigger Boat
1.plot: The NT is home to over 150,000 crocs and one man, Matt Wright, is on a quest to protect them all.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E02 - Life Insurance Ain't That Good, Baby
1.plot: A family fishing trip turns dangerous when the catch is bigger than expected; Matt reveals his unique bond with a wild crocodile; the boys are stalked during a risky night-time operation.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E03 - Sink or Swim
1.plot: Matt attempts to relocate a crocodile threatening human lives. An unexpected rookie joins the team causing frustration for Willow. An airboat mission is derailed by an emergency.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E04 - Don’t Hold Back
1.plot: Matt sets out to prove that perseverance pays off; the team races against the clock to catch an evasive croc; and a romantic fishing trip is ruined when Matt takes a dangerous detour.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E05 - Trouble in Paradise
1.plot: A sightseeing boat is stalked by an aggressive monster croc. An emergency phone call turns Matt's day upside down. Matt is tasked with apprehending an "uncatchable" crocodile.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E06 - Escape Artist
1.plot: The team chase a bait-robbing croc under the cover of darkness; a cunning escape artist forces Matt to pursue a new strategy; the boys launch a rescue mission to save a disoriented deadly predator.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E07 - Feeding Time
1.plot: The rookie Finn has his hands full at Matt's croc sanctuary. On the Tiwi Islands, a new build tests the team. A huge croc in a small waterhole sets nerves (and a boat) on edge.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E08 - Don’t Get Chewed
1.plot: With a flash flood predicted, Matt and Willow improvise a trap to tempt a hungry croc; Kaia and Banjo hone their foraging skills with a First Nations elder; Finn’s forgetfulness almost ends in disaster.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E09 - Wright or Wrong
1.plot: Kaia must deal with an unwanted visitor at home. A animal relocation tests Matt's skills for logistics and engineering. Banjo gets his first fishing rod. But will he catch a fish?

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E10 - The Reckoning
1.plot: The inexperienced Finn faces his last challenge; a teammate’s accomplishment is the subject of an outrageous celebration; Matt and Kaia unveil their stunning new home on the remote Tiwi Islands.

Wild Territory takes you inside the mission as legendary croc wrangler Matt Wright catches and relocates the biggest crocodiles on Earth to keep people and crocs safe.

meta.plot: Après avoir obtenu son diplôme, Molly Yoder quitte ses parents pour l'Arizona. Tandis que Miguel devient la fierté de sa famille en devenant le premier diplômé des Hernandez. Seulement tous deux n'avaient pas prévu que leurs projets futurs prennent une telle direction quand Molly apprend à Miguel qu'elle attend un enfant de lui. Les Yoder et les Hernandez, que tout oppose, vont devoir apprendre à vivre ensemble....

1.title: FR - Welcome to the Family - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Dan Yoder and wife Caroline are happily anticipating an empty nest as their daughter Molly gets ready to head off to college. Molly has some interesting news for them, however, and when she announces that she and her secret boyfriend Junior Hernandez are going to have a baby, they have to adjust to a new reality and meet their new family – Miguel and Lisette. When these two very different families are thrown together, it’s obvious that Dan and Miguel have the most difficult time adjusting to their new situation, while Caroline and Lisette take a softer approach.

1.title: FR - Welcome to the Family - S01E02 - Dan Finds Out
1.plot: Caroline heads to the doctor to confirm her suspicions but when she encounters Molly and Junior in the same waiting room, things get a little awkward. Then, as Joseph decides to invite his parents to the first sonogram, things get even more awkward. When Caroline later learns she is indeed pregnant, she struggles with the best way to break the news to Dan, who has been happily anticipating an empty nest. Meanwhile, Dan returns to Miguel’s boxing gym to get back into shape, and it doesn’t go well.

1.title: FR - Welcome to the Family - S01E03 - The Big RV Adventure
1.plot: In a moment of wistfulness about his long lost freedom, Dan decides to purchase an RV for a little recreational family time. Caroline is not completely thrilled about the purchase and is most concerned about finding relief for her mounting nausea and intense appetite. Miguel and Lisette attend Demetrio’s Back to School Night and meet Demetrio’s sixth grade teacher Ana Nunez – who turns out to be an old flame of Miguel’s. Lisette, who is already feeling awkward about becoming a grandmother, is not happy to meet the gorgeous Ana. Meanwhile, Molly looks to her mother for advice on why Junior may be feeling less romantic now that she’s pregnant.

1.title: FR - Welcome to the Family - S01E04 - Molly and Junior Find a Place
FR - Welcome to the Family - S01E05 - Halloween
1.plot: After landing a big client, Caroline eyes a promotion at work, but struggles to keep the pregnancy a secret until she can lock it in. Dan encourages Junior to lighten up a bit and have some fun so he considers rushing a fraternity on campus, which turns out to be Dan's old house. When Junior and Molly attend the Halloween costume party however, it becomes apparent that something has changed in the years since Dan was at school. Meanwhile, the Yoders entertain the Hernandez family for some Halloween trick-or-treating.

1.title: FR - Welcome to the Family - S01E06 - Dan and Miguel Play Ball
1.plot: When Dan is short a player in his weekly basketball game, he invites Miguel to join but when Dan accidentally elbows Miguel in the mouth, the game goes from bad to worse. During the game, Lisette offers to take Caroline to her favorite Mexican restaurant for an amazing burrito but the ladies realize that they have differing opinions about the family drama surrounding them. Meanwhile, Molly is horrified to learn that the lab where Junior works is using animals for testing and it comes between them.

1.title: FR - Welcome to the Family - S01E07 - Lisette’s Abuela Visits
1.plot: A visit by Lisette’s grandmother Lita, draws Molly and Caroline into a Hernandez family web of lies, including the old woman’s belief that Miguel is a lawyer.

1.plot: Reporter Gerd Heidemann needs a real scoop, as he hasn't had a big story in a while. Konrad Kujau, not making enough selling fake memorabilia to old Nazis, desperately needs money and has the idea of forging Hitler’s diaries.

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Kujau finally agrees to do business with Heidemann, and all it’s left is for Stern to approve payments. Hans admits his Nazi past, and Elisabeth helps him by destroying his file - unaware that she is photographed while doing it.

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Kujau forges some letters to provide Heidemann with documents to verify the diaries. Leo Gold threatens Elisabeth to reveal her father’s guilty past, if she won’t provide him with information about the diaries.

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Wishing to sell the international rights of the diaries, Stern approaches an American media mogul, who however has an agenda. Elisabeth, while trying to find out if Kujau is a fake, learns something upsetting about her father.

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Elisabeth tells the editors of Stern that she believes the diaries are fake, so Bloom has no choice but to fire her. Kujau panics with the impending publication of the diaries, so he forces Heidemann to keep his identity a secret.

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Following the publication of the diaries, Stern continues to assert that they are real, but what will the examination prove? Moreover, will Elisabeth be able to win back her place in Stern?

meta.plot: En 1978, le journaliste allemand Gerd Heidemann s'allie à Konrad Kujau un faussaire désargenté, pour écrire de faux journaux intimes d'Hitler. Retour sur un scandale.

1.title: FR - Chloe - S01E01 - There Is a Light

1.title: FR - Chloe - S01E03 - The Holy Trinity

1.title: FR - Chloe - S01E04 - However Rotten

1.title: FR - Chloe - S01E05 - Grimy Friend

1.title: FR - Chloe - S01E06 - She Called Me
1.plot: Becky’s carefully constructed web of lies begins to crumble around her and it’s a race against time to discover the truth before Elliot’s political launch.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Struggling to figure out where he fits in, Dean decides to pursue his calling as "The Great Uniter" and attempts to organize the first integrated baseball game between his team and his friend Brad's team.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E02 - Green Eyed Monster
1.plot: While Dean reckons with his first taste of heartbreak and betrayal, the adults in his life are overly empathetic and assume his grief is from mourning current events.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E03 - The Club
1.plot: Dean stumbles upon some “racy literature” and shares it with friends at school. When he is caught by the school principal, Bill and Lillian navigate uncharted territory as parents and Dean learns that manhood isn’t all it’s cracked up to be.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E04 - The Workplace
1.plot: It’s “Take Your Son to Work Day” and Dean heads to band practice with Bill. But the “grown folks’ business” at the music studio prompts Lillian to have to pick up Dean. While at her office, Dean finally learns what his mom does while he’s at school all day, gaining a newfound respect for her career and ambition.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E05 - The Lock In
1.plot: Dean is reluctant to attend the annual church lock-in until Kim tells him it’s where she got her first kiss. He enlists his friends to help him pair up with Keisa, but his plans are thwarted when he instead gets paired up with the pastor’s daughter, Charlene.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E06 - Be Prepared
1.plot: When Coach Long and Bill take the boys on a camping trip as part of their newly formed scout troop, their starkly different approaches to the outdoors show Dean that his father isn’t good at everything. As a thunderstorm threatens an eerie quest through the woods, Bill leans into his expertise to save the day.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E07 - Independence Day
1.plot: As Kim’s campaign for a car coincides with the need to take Grandaddy Clisby’s keys away, Bill proposes a solution that is only pleasing to him: Kim can drive, so long as she takes her grandfather and Dean around town. Later on at the mall, Dean is worried about seeming uncool when Clisby ends up chaperoning him and his friends, but Clisby has a few crowd-pleasing tricks up his sleeve.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E08 - Science Fair
1.plot: After seeing Dean bullied by Michael after school Lillian goes to confront his parents and learns he needs more compassion than discipline. Much to Dean’s dismay, she takes Michael under her wing and helps him with his project for the science fair – an event where Dean typically excels

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E09 - Home For Christmas
1.plot: Dean can’t wait to spend Christmas with his older brother, Bruce, when he returns home from Vietnam. But adjusting to life back in Montgomery comes with unexpected challenges for Bruce, and the rest of the Williams family rely on their favorite holiday traditions to bring cheer

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E10 - Lads and Ladies and Us
1.plot: Bill and Lillian decide to join high society club Lads & Ladies as a way to introduce Kim and Dean to positive influences in the community. Bill, Kim and Dean fit right in, but things take a turn when Lillian is treated differently for being a working mom.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E11 - Brad Mitzvah
1.plot: Brad works through his nerves preparing for his bar mitzvah speech while Dean ends his friendship with Keisa when Charlene tells him he can’t be friends with other girls. Things come to a head when the whole group comes together to celebrate Brad’s bar mitzvah.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E12 - I'm With The Band
1.plot: When Dean loses his position as first chair saxophone in the school band, Bill lays the pressure on him to earn it back.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E13 - The Valentine’s Day Dance
1.plot: Dean’s plans to ask Keisa to the Valentine’s Day Dance are foiled when another boy asks her out first after a new makeover makes her the talk of the school. Meanwhile, Bill and Lillian make Kim sign up for a Big Sister program to have extracurricular activities for her college applications.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E14 - Country Dean
1.plot: The family spends spring break with Lillian's parents in the countryside, and Dean lies to his cousins about city life in Montgomery to impress them. Meanwhile, Lillian helps to settle a land dispute between her parents and their neighbors to impress her difficult-to-please mother.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E15 - Black Teacher
1.plot: When their teacher goes on maternity leave, Dean, Cory and Keisa are excited to be taught by Mr. Brady, the school’s first Black teacher. Mr. Brady encourages the students to try out for the Knowledge Bowl team where Dean faces some unexpected challenges

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E16 - The Sleepover
1.plot: When Dean learns that Corey’s dad, Coach Long, is in the doghouse, he struggles to keep this secret from his friend.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E17 - Jobs and Hangouts
1.plot: Kim is excited to start her new job as a waitress at the local diner, which Dean adopts as his local hangout. When Kim experiences drama with her friends, she finds unlikely allies in a tough coworker and her younger brother.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E18 - Goose Grease
1.plot: When Dean comes down with the chicken pox on his way to a hunting trip with Bill and Grandaddy Clisby, Lillian forces the three of them to quarantine together. Clisby pushes homemade remedies on them out of his mistrust of doctors, but he’s forced to reckon with this when Dean’s condition worsens.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E19 - Love & War
1.plot: Bruce returns home from Vietnam, and the family is shocked to find out he is dating an older woman with an 8-year-old son with whom he is eager to start his life. When they learn more about Bruce’s latest deployment, they begin to understand his survivors’ guilt and come together to support him.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E20 - Bill's New Gig
1.plot: Bill is excited to have made tenure at the university, only to find that his focus on career and family has cost him his spot in his band; Bruce adjusts to living at home.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E21 - Where No Dean Has Been Before
1.plot: Dean tries to impress Keisa's cool new boyfriend by inviting him and his friends to a party Kim is throwing while Bill and Lillian are away for the night; things get out of hand just as Bill and Lillian arrive home.

meta.plot: Natsuki Subaru, an ordinary high school  student, is on his way home from the convenience store when he finds  himself transported to another world. As he's lost and confused in a new  world where he doesn't even know left from right, the only person to  reach out to him was a beautiful girl with silver hair. Determined to  repay her somehow for saving him from his own despair, Subaru agrees to  help the girl find something she's looking for.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The End of the Beginning and the Beginning of the End
1.plot: Natsuki Subaru is summoned to a parallel world on his way home from the convenience store. He's entranced at first by the fantasy world suddenly stretching before his eyes, but the cute girl he believes summoned him is nowhere to be found, and soon enough he's utterly lost. Then a gang of punks surrounds him, but he quickly learns that he doesn't have any of the powers that he thought all people transported to a parellel world should have. Just when he's about to be beaten senseless, a girl appears...

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Reunion with the Witch
1.plot: After being attacked by someone the first time, sliced open by Elsa the second time, and stabbed in the back by punks the third time, Subaru should have been dead, but found himself back where he started in the same parallel world every time. He finally realizes he’s acquired the power to go back to the time and place he started from, which he calls “Return by Death.” In hopes of changing the fate awaiting Felt, Satella, Old Man Rom, and himself, Subaru takes off for the fourth time.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Starting Life from Zero in Another World
1.plot: Subaru attempts to buy the insignia from Felt and return it to Satella before Elsa arrives at the loot house… but Satella arrives before the negotiations are complete, and Elsa still attacks them.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Happy Roswaal Mansion Family
1.plot: After being badly wounded by Elsa, Subaru somehow survived and awoke in the mansion of Margrave Mathers, in the Kingdom of Lugunica.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Morning of Our Promise Is Still Distant
1.plot: Subaru now lives and works in Roswaal’s mansion, working with Ram and Rem, and finally getting Emilia to agree to a date with him. But the day of their promised date never comes as Subaru keeps going back to the day he first awoke in the mansion. He’s confused at the thought that he Returned by Death despite having no memory of experiencing anything deadly, but he’s determined to repeat his previous actions up to the point of fulfilling his promise with Emilia.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Sound of Chains
1.plot: Subaru’s first day at the Roswaal mansion begins for the third time. The first time, he grew weak and died of unknown reasons in his sleep, and the second time, he was killed by an attacker. The sound of chains that he heard as he died the second time replays in his mind, waking him in a terrified, cold sweat. He has no idea what the killer is after, let alone who it is, so he makes a plan to leave the mansion on the fourth night and watch for the attack to happen.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Natsuki Subaru’s Restart
1.plot: Standing before Subaru is someone he never expected. The truth of the attacker’s identity leaves him bewildered, and he feels everything crumbling around him as he dies yet again. Then, for the fourth time, he awakes on his first day at the Roswaal mansion. This time, the night of the fourth day passes without incident, and Subaru is stunned as he greets the morning of the fifth day… but then the situation takes an unexpected turn.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - I Cried, Cried My Lungs Out, and Stopped Crying
1.plot: Subaru’s first day in Roswaal’s mansion begins for the fifth time. Determined to save everyone this time, he makes it a point to keep his best smile on his face in order to earn the trust of the mansion’s staff. But although he works his hardest to make them like him, his body begins to have trouble keeping up with his heart’s intentions. Soon Emilia is unable to bear the sight of him struggling any longer and takes an unexpected action…

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Meaning of Courage
1.plot: The scattered pieces of the puzzle finally come together, and Subaru realizes for certain that the shaman who cursed him is in the village at the foot of the mountains. He heads there with Ram and Rem and makes sure all the villagers touch him so that he can find out, with Beatrice’s help, who cast the curse. But the truth he finds is not what he expected, and he finds himself rushing toward the village again…

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Fanatical Methods Like a Demon
1.plot: Subaru risked his life to save the children from a pack of Ulgarm, but he was so powerfully cursed that there could be no saving him. Even Beatrice is unable to undo the complex web of curses on him, and says he’ll grow weak and die within half a day. The only way he can survive is if the entire Ulgarm pack is defeated, but time is not on his side. Subaru is ready to give up when he learns that Rem has gone into the forest by herself…

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Rem
1.plot: Knocked unconscious by Subaru’s attack, Rem dreams of an event in her past that she and Ram would rather forget… a sin for which Rem feels she can never be forgiven. After waking up, she tells Subaru that she’s just committed the same sin again. When the three of them are moments from being cornered by the Ulgarm pack, Subaru takes off to draw their attention so Ram and Rem can escape.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Return to the Capital
1.plot: At the order of the council of elders that manages Lugunica in the king’s absence, Wilhelm and Felix visit Roswaal’s mansion as emissaries. Emilia is required in the imperial capital right away, so Subaru asks her to take him along. Emilia tells him this won’t be a pleasure trip, but a push from Rem and Roswaal ends in her agreement, so Emilia and Subaru head to the capital. Now all of the candidates to be Lugunica’s next king are gathered, and the royal selection is underway.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Self-Proclaimed Knight Natsuki Subaru
1.plot: As Emilia joins Priscilla, Crusch, and Anastasia in a meeting of the royal selection participants, Reinhard enters the hall with Felt. According to a new prophecy seen on the Dragon Stone, there are five priestesses with the potential to be the kingdom’s next ruler. Reinhard announces that Felt is the fifth priestess, meaning it’s time to formally begin the royal selection, but Felt refuses to have any part in it.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - The Sickness Called Despair
1.plot: “I just wanted to protect her. That feeling wasn’t a lie. Where did I go wrong?” Rejected by the one who meant more to him than anything, Subaru is still unable to recognize that he may have done something irreversible. He then finds out that some disturbing movement has been detected within Roswaal’s domain, where Emilia and the others are. He’s certain that he can save them somehow, so in spite of Rem and Crusch’s opposition, Subaru makes his way back to Emilia…

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - The Outside of Madness
1.plot: Upon returning to Roswaal’s mansion, Subaru is greeted by an unbelievable sight and wails that this was not what he wanted to happen. Stricken with despair, everything before Subaru starts to go white as, finally, he hears a voice: “You were too late.”

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - The Greed of a Pig
1.plot: Subaru wakes up in front of the appa shop once again. Feeling boxed in on all sides due to his own lack of power to change the situation, he seeks the help of others. First, he seeks the help of Crush, who flatly declines any further involvement passed her contractual obligation of healing Subaru. His requests to Anastasia and Priscilla similarly go unanswered despite his pleas. Having wasted too much time, Subaru decides to at least try to get Emilia away from Roswaal’s mansion as early as possible. He then takes a dragon car back home with Rem.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Disgrace in the Extreme
1.plot: A mysterious figure appears before Subaru and his traveling companions. As the looming beast attacks with a deafening bellow amidst the darkness and fog, Rem determines that it will be too difficult to escape…

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - From Zero
1.plot: Subaru laments that he could not do anything or save anyone, and has no options left. Exhausted, he suddenly takes off running at full speed as if he’s made a decision…

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Battle Against the White Whale
1.plot: To save Emilia, Subaru approaches Crusch to negotiate the formation of an alliance. His terms are a bit difficult for Crusch to believe, but she can see that Subaru isn’t lying.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Wilhelm van Astrea
1.plot: Subaru has devoted everything he had, and done all he could do. His passion has captured Crusch’s heart, as well as Anastasia’s cooperation, and they all enter into the battle against the White Whale together.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - A Wager That Defies Despair
1.plot: Subaru and Rem are at a loss for words. The battle against the White Whale, which seemed to be going in their favor through attrition, suddenly took on completely different proportions. With their tactical superiority and advantage quickly dwindling, the combined forces all but get tangled up in the threads of despair. That’s when Subaru decides to yell out his next move…

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - A Flash of Sloth
1.plot: With the battle against the White Whale now over, the mercenary force setting up the blockade of the road comes back, Julius at the lead. His arrival gives rise to mixed feelings for Subaru, but after Julius sincerely thanks him for ridding the world of the monster, Subaru finds it in himself to apologize for his past behavior. The group now looks forward, ready to enter the Mathers domain…

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Nefarious Sloth
1.plot: The group is making its way in the Mathers domain when suddenly everyone but Subaru disappears and a strange, suffocating atmosphere seeps through the forest. He quickly figures out it is nothing but an illusion, and with help from Julius on the other side, dispels the barrier for everyone caught in it. However, arriving at the village doesn’t make convincing the residents to evacuate easy. Time is running out, and the invisible hand of sloth makes its presence at the back of Subaru’s mind more and more nefarious.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - The Self-Proclaimed Knight and the Greatest Knight
1.plot: Subaru devises a new plan to correct the mistake of the blank letter sent to the manor, encourage the evacuation of the villagers and move Emilia away from her current location. With these preparations complete, he enacts the second part of his plan designed to cut off the Fingers before severing the Unseen Hand once and for all.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E25 - That’s All This Story Is About
1.plot: Emilia is hurriedly ushered to the capital along with the villagers under the orders of a mysterious benefactor while escorted by a rag-tag group of individuals from various and opposing factions. She has but one question on her mind: who could this man be and why would he go so far? Meanwhile, Subaru and Julius face off against the Archbishop of Sin Betelgeuse for the ultimate time. Unfortunately, he is very persistent even beyond death, belying his nature of Sloth. Subaru is relentlessly chased while he catches up to Emilia to save her one last time and answer her question.

1.title: EN - Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E26 - Each One's Promise
1.plot: Amid dying countless times, Subaru finally led the troops to victory against the White Whale and struck down the schemes of the Sin Archbishop of Sloth. After overcoming a painful ending to his these ordeals, he was reunited at last with his beloved Emilia… only to learn that Rem’s existence had been erased from the world, wiped out by the White Whale somewhere in the middle of his death loop. And now that the White Whale is defeated, Subaru and the others face a crisis no one could have expected.

1.title: EN - Back to the Rafters [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Kung Pao Chicken

1.title: EN - Back to the Rafters [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Cross Currents

1.title: EN - Back to the Rafters [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Issues Management
1.plot: When Rachel comes home to secure Ruby as youth ambassador for one of her New York clients, she surprises everyone by arriving pregnant; further complicating everyone's lives.

1.title: EN - Back to the Rafters [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Most Together One in the Family
1.plot: When compared to the rest of the Rafters, Ben thinks his life is looking up. But Cassie is harboring a truth that will tear his blissful ignorance apart.

1.title: EN - Back to the Rafters [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Pounded
1.plot: Nathan finds self-reflection and healing at a wellness retreat in Buradeena. Meanwhile, Julie is forced to a conclusion about her future with Dave, and Ruby takes a stand against internet trolls.

1.title: EN - Back to the Rafters [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Pinch Me Linda
1.plot: Finally accepting that their parents might indeed be contemplating separate lives, Ben and Nathan propose desperate measures to save their parents' role model marriage.

1.title: FR - Best Leftovers Ever! - S01E02 - Game Day Gourmet

Dix femmes et dix hommes ont été réunis pour leurs compatibilités amoureuses grâce à des études physiologiques et comportementales. Leur objectif ? Identifier les 10 couples parfaits. A la clé ? 200 000 euros à se partager. Chaque semaine, ils se présenteront deux par deux à la cérémonie des couples pour proposer leurs "10 couples" de la semaine. Suite à cette cérémonie, ils sauront combien de couples parfaits ils ont, mais sans savoir lesquels. Un seul moyen d'avoir la certitude qu'un couple est parfait, la love machine, ils y auront accès une fois par semaine, à la suite d'un rendez-vous. Entre amour et jeu, les candidats seront-ils capable de faire la part des choses ?
